rationale: I read the complete held EO 11417 (33 FR 10625, July 24, 1968; the held extract also carries unrelated neighbouring rules): one sentence amending sec. 305 of EO 10973 of Nov. 3, 1961, 'as amended', by adding the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Domestic and International Business to the Development Loan Committee; no own term and no savings clause, and its operative effect exists only as text of EO 10973. I read the held full text of EO 12163 (44 FR 56673, Sept. 29, 1979) including secs. 1-902 to 1-905: sec. 1-903(a)(1) provides 'The following are revoked: (1) Executive Order No. 10973 of November 3, 1961, as amended', which removes the base order, with all its amendments (EO 11417 among them), from force, and sec. 1-905 makes it effective October 1, 1979. EO 11417 is not individually named in EO 12163, and the machine-selected ACT: spans for EO 12163 are wrong passages (allocation and references provisions) so I do not cite them; the basis is my reading of the actor text. Sec. 1-904 saves earlier delegations, determinations, regulations and similar actions 'made, issued, or entered into with respect to any function affected by this order' until amended or terminated; I read that as preserving executed administrative actions under the foreign-assistance functions, not the Development Loan Committee membership amendment, which is a rule of the revoked order's text, but this is a judgment recorded as a residual risk. The catalog note ('Revoked by: EO 12163, September 29, 1979') and 1989 row ('Revoked by EO 12163') agree but are leads only. Other machine-found chain orders (EO 11579, 11685, 11816, 11959, 12118) amend or supersede parts of EO 10973 and cannot end EO 11417 on their own. Provisional NO hypothesis only; the effective end (Oct. 1, 1979 per sec. 1-905) is not otherwise adjudicated.
